description: This file defines a class 'Topic' within the OpenCart admin controller namespace. The class contains an 'add' method that performs tasks related to catalog topics: clearing old data, listing current topics, and retrieving info for each topic. It interacts with models for task management and CMS topics, and loads language strings.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Controller class for handling catalog topics tasks in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Initializes catalog topic tasks: clears old data, lists current topics, and retrieves info for each topic, returning a success message.
